name: M. Tech. Project Part II
description:
It is an independent research project engaging students in systematic research themes, strong foundation and analysis, experimental/computational work, data analysis, developing critical problem-solving skills, and advanced research and technical knowledge in their specialized project domain. 
The MTP Part II necessitates significant time commitment, productive development, advanced research, comprehensive data analysis, and effective implementation. Students are encouraged to write a research article as a culmination of their one-year project, emphasizing positive deliverables, results and analysis, along with innovative, focused ideas.
